# Week 10 Start/Sit -- Wednesday Practice Report

**League-2 (Intuitech Fantasy), Week 10.** Current NFL week confirmed via `season_week.load_current_week_nflreadpy(2026)` = 10, cross-checked against `load_schedules()` (Thursday WAS@NYG 11/12, bulk of the slate Sunday 11/15, LAC@BAL Monday 11/16).

## Source and freshness

Primary source is the committed `weekly-report-week-10.json` fixture, built by CI on 2026-11-10 at 17:16 UTC with real FantasyPros consensus, ESPN injuries and LLM news -- current for this run (no self-generation needed). Overlaid with live `nflreadpy.load_injuries(2026)` for Week 10, checked 2026-11-11 ~20:10 UTC: **only NYG and WAS have filed** (the two teams playing Thursday). Every other rostered player's team -- LAR, IND, SEA, ATL, DET, CAR, CIN, NYJ, NO -- has not filed yet, so their fixture designations (all Healthy) stand, unconfirmed.

## Practice report

This is the Wednesday run, so this section is the point of it. Only two rostered players belong to teams that have filed:

| Player | Team | Designation (fixture) | Wed. practice | Resulting read |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cam Skattebo (RB) | NYG | **Out** (hamstring) | Full Participation | Conflicting -- see below |
| Isaiah Likely (TE) | NYG | Healthy | Not on NYG's injury report at all | Confirmed healthy |

Everyone else on the roster: practice bucket unknown, team has not filed, fixture designation (Healthy for all) stands unconfirmed.

**Skattebo is the real story.** The committed fixture ships him as Out (hamstring) with a play probability of 0.759 -- which is an internally strange pairing, since an Out tag normally implies a probability near zero, not 76%. Feeding NYG's actual Week 10 row into the repo's fitted `AvailabilityModel` (Out designation standing, since nflreadpy's row has Full Participation practice but no Week-10 game-status yet, so per the merge rule the fixture's Out stands) gives **P(play) of roughly 0.02-0.07**, not 0.759. His 2026 history supports real caution either way: he missed 3 of his last 4 games (Weeks 6, 8, 9) with this same hamstring, playing only Week 7 in between. This is genuinely unresolved -- Friday's final designation settles it, not this report.

## Start these ten

| Slot | Player | Opp | Exp. pts | P(play) | If-he-plays |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| QB | Tyler Shough | CAR | 18.48 | 0.973 | 19.00 |
| RB | Jonathan Taylor | MIA | 16.60 | 0.959 | 17.31 |
| RB | Cam Skattebo | WAS | 10.03 | 0.759* | 13.21 |
| WR | Jaxon Smith-Njigba | LV | 23.01 | 0.972 | 23.66 |
| WR | Drake London | KC | 16.01 | 0.972 | 16.46 |
| TE | Isaiah Likely | WAS | 12.17 | 0.952 | 12.78 |
| FLEX | Tee Higgins | PIT | 16.58 | 0.971 | 17.07 |
| FLEX | Jameson Williams | NE | 11.93 | 0.971 | 12.29 |
| K | Jake Bates | NE | 8.34 | 0.987 | 8.45 |
| DEF | Jets D/ST | BUF | 5.28 | 1.000 | 5.28 |
| **Total** | | | **138.43** | | |

*Skattebo's P(play) is the fixture's number, not the fitted model's recompute -- see Practice report above and caveats.

Start Shough over bench Stafford (+2.76 expected: 18.48 vs 15.72) and Jameson Williams over bench Coker at the second FLEX (+1.66: 11.93 vs 10.27) -- both swaps the model already had in place Monday and confirms again on the real fixture. Likely over LaPorta at TE is a thinner edge now (+0.28: 12.17 vs 11.89) but still favors Likely.

## Changes since Monday

No new player swaps -- Monday's self-generated run (sandbox-degraded, in-house-only numbers) had already landed on the same optimal lineup (Shough/Likely/Jameson Williams over Stafford/LaPorta/Coker). What changed is the source: this run uses the real CI fixture (FantasyPros consensus + ESPN injuries), which moved the lineup total from 136.32 to **138.43** (+2.11) with no lineup changes. The one real update is Skattebo's designation hardening from "no live Week 10 status yet" (Monday) to an explicit **Out** (Tuesday's fixture) -- which Wednesday's practice data then complicates rather than confirms (see above).

## Still uncertain

- **Cam Skattebo (RB, NYG)** -- Out per the fixture, Full Participation per Wednesday's practice, no game-status posted for Week 10 yet. The single biggest swing factor in this lineup: he's the only rostered RB behind Taylor, so a Friday scratch leaves that slot scoring zero with no bench replacement. Consider a waiver RB add now as a hedge.
- Every other rostered player not on NYG/WAS: no team has filed yet, so "Healthy" is an absence of information, not a clean bill of health. Recheck Thursday/Friday.

## Opponent notes

- JSN vs LV remains the softest matchup on the roster and the week's top projection.
- Shough vs CAR's generous pass defense continues to support starting him over Stafford.

## Byes ahead

- **Week 10 (this week):** Bucky Irving (RB, TB) -- the reason Skattebo is forced into the lineup. Bo Nix (QB, DEN) is also on bye, bench-only, no impact.
- **Week 11:** Triple bye -- Matthew Stafford (QB, LAR), Jaxon Smith-Njigba (WR, SEA), Drake London (WR, ATL). A real point-production dip, though Irving returns and TE depth (LaPorta/Likely) covers FLEX, so no slot goes empty.
- **Week 13 (outside the two-week window, flagged early):** Jonathan Taylor (RB, IND) and the Jets D/ST both land on bye the same week -- worth watching the waiver wire.
